_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

elemental-dps.purpose: Lightning Bolt spam with Elemental Mastery / Elemental Focus; mana is the wall.
constraints: 'Elemental Shaman talent builds are typically very defined, with certain talents being mandatory for throughput, and others helping to prevent you from running out of Mana early' (model: raid mana weight 0.5)
Eye of the Storm / Storm Reach are PvP-solo preference points in raid builds ('you can swap them to Totemic Focus and Elemental Warding if you only want to focus on raiding')

Eye of the Storm.why: PvP/solo preference point in the raid build.

Totemic Focus.why: Cheaper totems: every fight starts with 3-4 totems.

Convection.why: Mana on Lightning Bolt / shocks - the core mana talent.

Call of Flame.encoded: parsed dmg on the fire totem source

enhancement-dps.purpose: Two-hander Windfury melee; in raids the spec is half support (Windfury Totem for the melee group, Mana Tide, totem mana).
constraints: raid value is largely support (Windfury Totem, Mana Tide, Grace of Air) which the model scores as utility, so Restoration support talents look cheap
leveling: Anticipation dodge and totem mana matter more than crit

Anticipation.why: Dodge for a melee who takes hits; raid filler.

Totemic Focus.why: Totem mana: the support half of the spec.

Restorative Totems.why: Mana Spring / Healing Stream for the group.

Improved Weapon Totems.why: Windfury Totem for the melee group (your own imbue overrides it).

Enhancing Totems.why: Strength of Earth / Grace of Air for the group.

Thundering Strikes.why: 1% crit per rank; low at leveling crit rates, taken as the tier-1 path.

Flurry.why: +25% attack speed for three swings after a melee crit: the enhancement haste loop; the fight lab fits it near 0.4%/point while leveling because fights are short and crit is low before 60.

Elemental Weapons.why: +40% Windfury Weapon effect (beta): the imbue that is 23-33% of enhancement damage in the simulators; Enhancement tier-3 path.

Spirit Weapons.why: Parry chance and threat changes (beta): survivability while leveling; one point on the path.

Maelstrom Weapon.why: Melee hits stack -20% cast time and mana on the next Lightning Bolt, five stacks (beta): instant Lightning Bolts inside the melee loop. The fight lab's enhancement module does not proc it yet, so its leveling value is a manual estimate.

Rage of the Farseer.why: +30% attack speed for 25 s (beta): the enhancement cooldown; one point.

resto-heal.purpose: Chain Heal / Healing Wave healer with Mana Tide and totem support.
loop: Healing Wave on the tank (Healing Way stacks)
constraints: Totemic Focus and Healing Grace are the tier fillers with a use (totem mana, threat)
